bug.description: What steps will reproduce the problem? 1. The attachment is the Bullet physics library, compiled from C++ to JS using Emscripten. 2. I tried to compile it using the Closure Compiler, latest downloadable version (Apr 5 2011), with java -jar apr5compiler.jar --compilation_level ADVANCED_OPTIMIZATIONS --variable_map_output_file js.vars --js bullet_1_1_q1.js --js_output_file bullet_1_1_q1.cc.js What is the expected output? What do you see instead? I would expect it to compile successfully.
